# Contributing

Thanks for wanting to help.

1. Open an issue first for anything bigger than a small fix, so we can agree on
   the approach.
2. Install the hooks with `pre-commit install`, if the repository has a
   `.pre-commit-config.yaml`.
3. Keep changes focused, and run the tests before opening a pull request.

**Kloud Workspace** *(the `workspace` and `ws-*` repositories)* has an in-depth
[contribution guide](https://ws.kloudkit.com/contribute), and takes its issues in
[ws-meta](https://github.com/kloudkit/ws-meta/issues).
